utterances.text: You see, there is the entry hole, which is about 20 or maybe 10 millimeters, and then it -- and then it exploded, it fragmented. It got it and then it exploded. I don't see what you mean.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: All right. I understand that.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: Mr. President, I wonder whether we have enough time to show the video at this point. Perhaps just that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We might have enough time to show the video, but I wonder whether it wouldn't be better to have the questioning immediately following the showing of the video, because we might have to show it again tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: If you have got no other questions unrelated to the video, then we'll have a break. If there's anything you say that's totally unrelated to that and covers a different matter, then we'll go on for a few more minutes.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: There are a few other questions, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: At the time your son was shot, did you see any military vehicles in the vicinity?

utterances.speaker: FAJKO KADRIC
utterances.text: No, there was nothing.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: Did you see any United Nations vehicles in the vicinity?

utterances.speaker: FAJKO KADRIC
utterances.text: Yes, further ahead of us, about a hundred metres.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: What did you see?

utterances.speaker: FAJKO KADRIC
utterances.text: An APC.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: Did the APC have any markings on it?

utterances.speaker: FAJKO KADRIC
utterances.text: I can't recall now.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: All right. I think you said you saw an APC in response to my question as to whether you saw any UN vehicles in the vicinity. What led you to conclude it was a United Nations APC?

utterances.speaker: FAJKO KADRIC
utterances.text: It was standing in the Djure Jakisca Street where I had stopped.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: You said earlier that you had received some assistance from UNPROFOR people after your son was shot. Where does those --

utterances.speaker: FAJKO KADRIC
utterances.text: Yes, they were the ones.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: All right. And indeed, was the first place your son was taken to a hospital?

utterances.speaker: FAJKO KADRIC
utterances.text: First I stopped at the UNPROFOR vehicle, and then they helped him. This is the Ukrainians, and then they took him to the PTT. This was about 2 kilometres.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: In the PTT building, was there a French hospital?

utterances.speaker: FAJKO KADRIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: Was that where he was taken to?

utterances.speaker: FAJKO KADRIC
utterances.text: Yes. And he was operated on there.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: Is that a convenient place, Mr. President?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, thank you, Mr. Ierace. Mr. Kadric, we're not finished yet. But since this courtroom is used this afternoon to hear another case, this means that we have to adjourn now, and we'll restart -- resume tomorrow morning. Madam Registrar, I do understand well we're in the same courtroom, 9.00 tomorrow morning? Yes, please, Mr. Ierace.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: Just quickly Mr. President before we adjourn, just before this witness's evidence commenced, Mr. Piletta-Zanin referred to a map as being a 1998 map. I'd be grateful if he could indicate whether that was a Defence map or a Prosecution map. If it was a Prosecution map, it was incorrect.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, I think he intended to tell us what was the date of his map, the map of --

utterances.speaker: MR. PILETTA-ZANIN
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. Yes, Mr. President, I was just doing that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, and we're still waiting for the year -- or do you have by now, Mr. Ierace?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: So the Defence is one year ahead. Yes, Mr. Piletta-Zanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. PILETTA-ZANIN
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, this is just to say that it could be a 1997, but on the map that I saw, it said 2001, so we have to be absolutely certain what's going on on the map produced by the Prosecution. We could see in the right hand corner 2001, which seems to me this is the year, and I think we should check.

utterances.speaker: MR. IERACE
utterances.text: That's the reproduction year, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That's the reproduction year. That's the answer. If there's any doubt about it, then we'll hear from it. Then, Mr. Kadric, we'll adjourn, and everyone else in this courtroom, we'll adjourn until tomorrow morning, 9.00, same courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: reconvened on Friday, the 15th day of February, 2002, at 9.00 a.m.
